skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply auditing knowledge to identify key characteristics and perform audit tests on specific audit subjects in various industries.
Evaluate risks and design audit procedures for financial statements in various industries.
Implement audit procedures based on risk assessment for financial statements in various industries.
Use knowledge of accounting and auditing to assess and improve audit activities.
Ensure compliance with auditing standards and ethical principles in various industries.
Identify and address issues arising from the application of auditing standards and ethical principles in specific contexts.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches during audits in specific industries.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in making audit judgments and evaluations in specific industries.
